# Spellmerge

> A 2D top-down roguelite about building deep, combinable spells, for 1–4 local co-op players. Made in Godot 4.7 with typed GDScript only, in 32×32 pixel art. Claude, an AI, writes and maintains it; players shape it through Issues and Discussions. Links are paths relative to the repository root.

Start with AGENTS.md for the hard rules, then docs/DESIGN.md (nothing may contradict it) and the README of the area you will touch.

## Start here

- [README.md](README.md): what the project is, how to play and how to join in.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the guide for coding agents: hard rules, untrusted text, how to work, checks to run.
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): Claude Code entry point; it only imports AGENTS.md.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): for players: how to report a bug or share an idea, and what happens next.
- [CLA.md](CLA.md): the Contributor License Agreement signed by contributors before the community intake (2026-10-22).

## Plan and design

- [docs/DESIGN.md](docs/DESIGN.md): the vision and pillars; owner-only, and every task is checked against it.
- [docs/PLAN.md](docs/PLAN.md): the full owner-approved project plan: security model, path tiers, roadmap, quality bar.
- [docs/ROADMAP.md](docs/ROADMAP.md): the eight sequential milestones and what each builds.
- [docs/milestones/M0-foundation.md](docs/milestones/M0-foundation.md): design of M0, the infrastructure before any gameplay; closed early, its dry runs carry into M1.
- [docs/milestones/M1-core-loop.md](docs/milestones/M1-core-loop.md): design of M1, the core loop prototype (one spell, one enemy, one room, 4-player co-op), its parts in build order and checkpoint C1; closed by the owner's go at C1, its open items carry into M2.
- [docs/milestones/M2-spell-system.md](docs/milestones/M2-spell-system.md): design of M2, the spell system (18 components, the runtime in `core/spells`, reactions, limits, the builder, validators, combos, stress benchmark, Story), its parts in build order and checkpoint C2.
- [docs/STORY.md](docs/STORY.md): the story canon and tone: how the world sounds, what is fixed (wizards, the guild, elements, the crypt, imps) and the rules for writing text.
- [docs/STYLE.md](docs/STYLE.md): the art rules: 32×32 grid, palette, light from the top-left, outline, shades, frame counts, placeholder SVG rules; provisional until M2.
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): the layers, where each kind of change goes (content, art, events) and the art contract a replacement must keep.
- [docs/NEXT.md](docs/NEXT.md): the ordered task queue for the current milestone.
- [docs/BACKLOG.md](docs/BACKLOG.md): ideas and future work outside the current milestone.
- [docs/DECISIONS.md](docs/DECISIONS.md): why things were decided, newest first, so they are not reversed by accident.
- [docs/LOG.md](docs/LOG.md): a short entry per development session, newest first.

## Operations

- [docs/SETUP-APP.md](docs/SETUP-APP.md): how to set up the Spellmerge Bot GitHub App (owner-only).
- [docs/SECURITY-CHECKLIST.md](docs/SECURITY-CHECKLIST.md): checklist for verifying the security model after setup or a settings change (owner-only).
- [.github/pull_request_template.md](.github/pull_request_template.md): the PR template for the bot's and the owner's PRs.

## Area contracts

Each area README states the area's job, the milestone that builds and opens it, the file types allowed, an entry script and the dependency direction `core` ← `gameplay` ← `content`.

- [core/README.md](core/README.md): shared services: event bus, registry, input, saving, base classes, projectile manager, pools.
- [hud/README.md](hud/README.md): panels, spell builder UI, menus, widgets and the one theme.
- [gameplay/README.md](gameplay/README.md): shared rules for the gameplay sub-areas and an events-at-a-glance table.
- [gameplay/ai/README.md](gameplay/ai/README.md): shared enemy behaviours: steering, targeting, attack patterns.
- [gameplay/combat/README.md](gameplay/combat/README.md): damage pipeline, hit and hurt boxes, knockback, status effects, element reactions.
- [gameplay/coop/README.md](gameplay/coop/README.md): joining and leaving mid-run, friendly fire, shared camera.
- [gameplay/difficulty/README.md](gameplay/difficulty/README.md): scaling by player count, depth and setting.
- [gameplay/feel/README.md](gameplay/feel/README.md): hit-stop, screen shake and juice presets.
- [gameplay/flow/README.md](gameplay/flow/README.md): room sequence, door voting, transitions, waiting for builders.
- [gameplay/player/README.md](gameplay/player/README.md): wizard controller: move, dodge, cast, mana, health, downed, revive.
- [gameplay/progression/README.md](gameplay/progression/README.md): hub, unlocks, currency, codex.
- [gameplay/rewards/README.md](gameplay/rewards/README.md): per-player loot rolls, unspent rewards, shops.
- [gameplay/run/README.md](gameplay/run/README.md): run lifecycle: start, seed, end, summary screen.
- [content/spells/README.md](content/spells/README.md): spell components: forms, elements, modifiers, triggers.
- [content/relics/README.md](content/relics/README.md): passive items that change how spells behave.
- [content/wizard/README.md](content/wizard/README.md): cosmetics and staffs for the base wizard.
- [content/enemies/README.md](content/enemies/README.md): regular enemies and their attack patterns.
- [content/bosses/README.md](content/bosses/README.md): multi-phase boss fights.
- [content/rooms/README.md](content/rooms/README.md): room templates, one folder per biome.
- [content/story/README.md](content/story/README.md): lore, dialogue and in-run story events.
- [art/README.md](art/README.md): shared art (tilesets, UI, VFX): 32×32 pixel art, size limits, origin manifest.
- [art/kit/README.md](art/kit/README.md): the art starter kit sources: palette files, grid and strip templates, golden examples, one-page checklist.
- [audio/README.md](audio/README.md): shared audio (music, sound effects): `.ogg` only, size limits, origin manifest.
- [tests/README.md](tests/README.md): the test tree, smoke test, benchmark and bots.
- [tools/README.md](tools/README.md): local tools: how to run `tools/check.sh`, its flags and output.

## Tools and checks

- [tools/check.sh](tools/check.sh): runs the hard rules CI enforces on your changes; run it before committing.
- [art/manifest.json](art/manifest.json): origin record (human or ai, author, license) for every art asset.
- [audio/manifest.json](audio/manifest.json): origin record for every audio asset.
- [REUSE.toml](REUSE.toml): default licenses: GPL-3.0-or-later for code, CC-BY-SA-4.0 for assets.

- [.github/maintainer/revise.md](.github/maintainer/revise.md): prompt for revising a PR after review.
